findings.message: Hero headline is 14 words ("Postavíme vám systém, který dělá tu práci, co u vás dneska d"). Gallery median is 5.
findings.fix: Say the one thing. Move the rest to the supporting line.

findings.message: 7 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "Digitalizace a automatizace procesů" above "Postavíme vám systém, který dělá tu prác"; "Systémy" above "Šest věcí, které stavíme."; "Postup" above "Jak to probíhá"; "Před a po" above "Jak to vypadá dneska a jak potom."; "Srovnání" above "Čím se to liší od ostatních cest."
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: Decorative index numbers: "02", "03", "04", "05", "06", "07"
findings.fix: Remove them. If order truly matters, write it into the words ("First, …") or use a real <ol>.

findings.message: 20 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "Digitalizace a automatizace procesů", "Systémy", "02", "Postup").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.

findings.message: 6 gradient fill(s): div.hero-bg__fallback → radial-gradient(46% 52% at 64% 44%, oklch(0.7083 0.149 68.8 / 0.5), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 68%), radial-gradient(40% | div.hero-bg__mask → radial-gradient(55% 45% at 50% 46%, oklab(0.11 0.00216975 0.00559394 / 0.7), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 70%), linear-gra | div.ba__card.ba__card--before → linear-gradient(oklch(0.21 0.009 68.8) 0%, oklch(0.185 0.008 68.8) 100%)
findings.fix: Use a flat colour or a real image. The only gradient allowed by default is a neutral scrim over a photo for legibility.

findings.message: 39 gradient-filled text element(s).
findings.fix: Solid colour text.

findings.message: 12 text-shadow(s).

findings.message: Buttons with gradient fill and shadow/glow.

findings.message: 15 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): li 514px | li 514px | li 514px | li 514px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.

findings.message: 3 boxes drawn with a 1px outline.
findings.fix: Define a surface by its fill (one tone step from the page) or leave the content unboxed.

findings.message: 1 dashed/dotted border(s).
findings.fix: Remove unless it is a real drop zone.

findings.message: 3 backdrop-blur surfaces.
findings.fix: One blurred sticky bar at most; glass cards are a tell.

findings.message: Yellow-cream background (text #f8f4f1).
findings.fix: Use the drawn palette. If you want warmth, take a low-chroma stone or bone, not a yellow cream.

findings.message: Low-contrast text: "8:42" 3.2:1 needs 4.5:1; "8:41" 3.8:1 needs 4.5:1; "Dvě věty o tom, co děláte, a hned pod tí" 3.8:1 needs 4.5:1; "Zapsáno do přehledu · čeká na potvrzení" 4.3:1 needs 4.5:1
findings.fix: Darken or lighten the text colour.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: Only 0 real photograph(s) or clip(s); the rest are interface fragments.
findings.fix: Add two or more real pictures of the customer's world from scripts/assets.mjs, not stock of people at laptops.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: 1 text block(s) under 13px.
findings.fix: Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: Large text lies under another element at some scroll position: "FaiN" (screen 1, 100% hidden); "Postavíme vám systém, který dělá tu práci," (screen 1, 38% hidden); "co u vás dneska dělá někdo rukou." (screen 1, 50% hidden)
findings.fix: Nothing may sit on top of a headline or statement. Move the picture, shorten the pinned run, or raise the text above it (z-index) and give it a ground.

findings.message: Pinned large text slides across pictures while the page scrolls: "FaiN" (screen 1, 100% over a picture)
findings.fix: Jurors read a pinned title crossing drawings or photographs as a collision. Keep the pictures in the column the title does not occupy, or unpin it.
